cat > /tmp/cand1.sql <<'EOF'
WITH pair AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(syn.domainid) AS domainid, MAX(syn.posid) AS posid
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
), ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt, domainid, posid,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM pair
), agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN synsetid END) AS top_synsetid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN cnt END) AS top_synset_sense_count
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids, top_synsetid, top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg JOIN words w ON w.wordid = agg.wordid
WHERE total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF

WITH multi AS (
  SELECT wordid FROM senses GROUP BY wordid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

  FROM senses s
  WHERE s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM multi)
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
), pair AS (
  SELECT p.wordid, p.synsetid, p.cnt, syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM pair0 p JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = p.synsetid
), agg AS (
  SELECT wordid, COUNT(*) AS total_synsets, SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains, COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids,
         MAX(cnt) AS top_synset_sense_count, MAX(cnt * 1000000 - synsetid) AS top_key
  FROM pair GROUP BY wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids,
       top_synset_sense_count * 1000000 - top_key AS top_synsetid, top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg JOIN words w ON w.wordid = agg.wordid
WHERE total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;
